payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the performance of word and morpheme segmentation, indicating that while morpheme supervision can improve word segmentation, it does not necessarily enhance morpheme boundary detection.

claims.text: Morpheme supervision improves word segmentation but does not improve morpheme boundary detection, leading to undersegmentation issues.
The segmentation tasks for words and morphemes are closely related and rely on similar tools, indicating a connection between the two.
Using morphemes as supervision can yield better results for word segmentation due to the overlap between words and morphemes.
